grants.title: Mitochondrial Transfer into Granulocytes
grants.summary: Testing whether donated mitochondria can extend the useful life of short-lived immune first responders and reduce excess inflammation.

grants.title: Open-Access Albumin-Binding Domains for Nanobody Half-Life Extension
grants.summary: Designing patent-free protein tags that let tiny antibody drugs stay in the bloodstream for days rather than hours.
grants.imageAlt: Illustration of an albumin-binding domain joined to a therapeutic minibinder

grants.title: Valonia ventricosa Genome Sequencing
grants.summary: Sequencing the first genome of a grape-sized single cell and creating public infrastructure for giant-cell biology.
grants.imageAlt: Microscope image of Valonia ventricosa cells

grants.title: mRNA-Based Reprogramming of Macrophage Inflammation in Diabetic Wounds
grants.summary: Finding molecular switches that restore the productive immune response diabetic wounds need in order to heal.

grants.title: Banana Pith Cellulose Nanofibers for Sustainable Cosmetics
grants.summary: Turning banana-harvest waste into a cleaner, microplastics-free cosmetic ingredient using an enzyme-led process.
grants.imageAlt: Close photograph of the translucent texture of a cellulose material

grants.title: Carroucell: Automated Carousel Staining Battery
grants.grantee: Lucía Nerea Perez, Anika Sasaki & Julieta Hernandez
grants.summary: Building an open, roughly $100 robot that makes tissue staining reproducible for labs that cannot buy commercial automation.
grants.imageAlt: Top view of the Carroucell tissue-staining hardware

grants.title: Open-Synth: Decentralized Enzymatic DNA Synthesis Platform
grants.summary: Building an open enzyme-and-droplet DNA printer that replaces toxic, centralized synthesis with bench-scale infrastructure.
grants.imageAlt: Open Cartridge DNA-synthesis hardware on a laboratory bench
